run_stereo_training: run the CroCo model training pipeline for stereo depth estimation on a specified dataset
run_flow_training: run the CroCo model training pipeline for optical flow estimation on a specified dataset
build_args_parser: build an argparse parser with stereo and flow subcommands for CroCo model finetuning configuration
train_one_epoch: train the CroCo downstream binocular model for one epoch using the provided criterion and metrics
validate_one_epoch: validate the CroCo model on test datasets and compute stereo or flow evaluation metrics
